Unknown: contribution margin, fixed costs, and causal lift. Smallest next step: continue the current measurement and repair queues. Owner decision: authorize sending the prepared Woot permission request; all launch gates remain blocked until rights, Legal, Security, accuracy, and measurement evidence are complete.
